Maya (AE): FYI team — Riverbank signed the NDA and wants a POC to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. They're asking for a short playbook: prompt parity, response diffs, pricing delta, and security questionnaire handoff. Can eng/security own the checklist?
Devon (ML Eng): I can run a response-diff harness. Need a sample of their production prompts (redacted) and expected latency SLA. also, are they using streamed responses?
Maya (AE): yes, ~30k monthly active users, streaming chat, SLA target 200ms p50 for short prompts. I'll ask them for a 48h sample export and their rate patterns.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For parity testing I recommend a 3-step POC: 1) Adapter shim to map CompetitorX payload -> Redwood API, 2) response normalization (dates, IDs), 3) golden prompt suite run. I can ship a starter proxy.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Example mapping snippet (quick):
```bash
# proxy maps incoming competitorX request to /v1/responses
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses -d '{"input": "{{text}}","model":"redwood-large"}'
```
Devon (ML Eng): TIP: set sampling to deterministic-ish for parity runs: top_p=0.0, temperature=0, and use same tokenization preproc. CompetitorX uses byte-level tokenization; we may need to normalize whitespace.
Ari (Product): Also note that CompetitorX applies light post-processing (answer trimming). That will create apparent deltas even if underlying logits are similar. Put postproc in the comparator.
Jordan (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Need answers for: where logs live, data retention, SSO (SAML/SCIM), egress IP ranges, and contract-level encryption (KMS/HSM). Send vendor risk form; I'll start completing sections.
Maya (AE): I'll upload their security questionnaire to the shared drive and give @Jordan editor access.
Devon (ML Eng): One more: if they rely on streaming token-by-token hooks, we should exercise our streaming endpoints with identical chunk sizes to measure behavioral diffs.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For short POC timeline (2 weeks): Day 1-2 adapter + traffic replay, Day 3-6 run golden prompts + diff analysis, Day 7-10 iterate prompt fixes/filters, Day 11-14 joint review + pricing estimate.
Maya (AE): Pricing ask — they want projected per-1000-message cost vs CompetitorX. @Ari can you prepare a delta calc that includes batching/quantization effects?
Ari (Product): On it. I need typical sequence lengths from their sample. Also note dedicated capacity impacts unit price — include hosted vs dedicated scenarios.
Jordan (Security): One blocker we saw with similar customers: their legal requires SOC2 + customer-specific logging retention. Redwood's Private option can cover data residency. I'll list the controls they asked for and match to our offerings.
Devon (ML Eng): Quick question: do we need to provide deterministic seed support for parity tests? CompetitorX supports "seed" param. We don't expose seed publicly but can run an internal fixed-seed job.
Priya (Solutions Eng): We can do internal fixed-seed for POC. We'll document differences and recommended prompt wrappers.
ops-bot: scheduled:replay-batch created by Priya — replay job id 8734 queued (ETA 12m).
Maya (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank to send 48h prompt sample + SQ, 2) Priya to deploy adapter and start replay, 3) Jordan to start SQ answers, 4) Ari + Devon to prepare parity/runbook and cost delta. Target sync in 8 business days. @everyone please ack. :thumbsup:
Devon (ML Eng): ack
Priya (Solutions Eng): ack
Ari (Product): ack
Jordan (Security): ack
Maya (AE): thanks — I'll book the sync and loop in legal for contract items.
